page_title: OSA 0-0 SEV | Osasuna v Sevilla 23/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) but poses no threat.
90+3' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Moi Gomez (Osasuna), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
90+2' Kike Barja (Osasuna) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

90+2' Osasuna will have a chance to score from a corner kick. Kike Barja (Osasuna) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' One of the players from Sevilla times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
89' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Sergio Herrera makes a great save to stop his effort.
89' Kike Barja (Osasuna) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop.
88' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
85' Here comes a substitution. Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is brought on as a substitute for Ante Budimir.
85' Ruben Pena goes off the pitch and Jesus Areso (Osasuna) comes on.
85' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Chimy Avila will be replaced by Raul (Osasuna).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oliver Torres trots off the pitch and is replaced by Djibril Sow (Sevilla).
83' The ball is cleared out of defence to the edge of the box where Chimy Avila (Osasuna) hits a first-time shot back towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball flashes well past the left post.
81' The linesman signals that Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
81' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) was quite harsh and Ignacio Iglesias Villanueva didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
80' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) takes the corner with a short pass.
79' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Sevilla get a corner.
78' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the right post.
77' It will be a substitution. Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) is ready to enter the pitch as Kike Salas walks off.
76' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot.
75' Joan Jordan (Sevilla) hits the direct free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save.
74' Joan Jordan (Sevilla) is about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position, just outside the box.
74' Tempers flare after Lucas Torro (Osasuna) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
72' Unlucky! A great strike from Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
70' Jose Luis Mendilibar prepares a substitution. Rafa Mir is replaced by Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla).

70' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Orjan Nyland guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
68' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Iker Munoz and he is replaced by Moi Gomez (Osasuna).
68' Substitution. Johan Mojica makes his way off the pitch and Kike Barja (Osasuna) comes on as his replacement.
68' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) has tested the patience of referee Ignacio Iglesias Villanueva and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
67' Kike Salas (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
64' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ignacio Iglesias Villanueva had an easy-decision to make.
64' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
64' Kike Salas (Sevilla) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sevilla.
62' Osasuna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
62' The linesman makes the right call and Osasuna will have a corner. Johan Mojica (Osasuna) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
62' A great pass puts Chimy Avila (Osasuna) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the right post.

60' Rafa Mir (Sevilla) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Sergio Herrera pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
58' Chimy Avila almost found himself in a promising position after Ruben Pena (Osasuna) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
57' Ignacio Iglesias Villanueva shows a yellow card to Kike Salas (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.
55' Rafa Mir (Sevilla) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
54' Flag goes up against Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
53' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) works the corner short.
53' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. It will be a corner kick for Osasuna.
52' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Sergio Herrera has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
51' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
50' A quickly taken corner by Osasuna.
49' The attendance is 19670.
48' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
48' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla). Sevilla win a corner.
47' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
45+2' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Osasuna was in an offside position.
44' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
42' Sevilla keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
40' Johan Mojica picks out Lucas Torro (Osasuna), who drives a shot just over the crossbar from the edge of the box.
39' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets too much on the ball and it goes well wide of the left post.
39' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
38' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) tries to find Lucas Ocampos, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
35' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
32' The current number of shots on goal is 0:0.
30' A cross from a corner kick by Osasuna is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
30' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The referee signals a corner kick to Osasuna.
29' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
27' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) makes a slide tackle, but referee Ignacio Iglesias Villanueva blows for a foul.
25' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Osasuna.
24' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
23' Rafa Mir (Sevilla) is flagged for offside.
20' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
18' Joan Jordan (Sevilla) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
17' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) meets a cross from the flank and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box, but the ball flies high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
15' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
13' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
11' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) tries to threaten the goalkeeper as he takes the ball and fires from long range. The shot flies just over the crossbar!
10' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.

8' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
7' The resulting set piece from Osasuna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
7' The ball is cleared after Johan Mojica (Osasuna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman points to the corner flag, Osasuna are going to take it.
4' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
3' A cross is whipped into the box by Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) and Lucas Torro controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
2' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Sevilla will take the kick-off.
Ignacio Iglesias Villanueva got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
